reach: public HTTP entry measured — `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` with `timezone: "America/New_York"` returns wrong bucket keys and wrong per-bucket counts on a stock showcase boot (reproduced by two independent runners).

Checklist item priority: P1
type: Bug

## What is wrong

The in-memory date-bucket labeller shifts a `Field.date` value — a timezone-naive calendar day under ADR-0053 ("never converted to an instant and never timezone-shifted") — one calendar day EARLIER whenever the requested reference timezone has a negative UTC offset. The SQL pushdown path labels the same rows correctly, so the two bucket paths disagree, and bucket totals move across day / week / month / quarter / year edges.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, `--seed-admin`, admin bearer)

1. `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` body `{"cube":"showcase_delivery","measures":["showcase_delivery.count"],"timeDimensions":[{"dimension":"showcase_delivery.due_date","granularity":"day"}],"timezone":"UTC"}` → keys equal the stored `due_date` values (2026-10-01, 2026-10-13, 2026-10-21, …); the answer carries `sql` (`strftime('%Y-%m-%d', due_date)`), i.e. the driver path.
2. Same body with `"timezone":"America/New_York"` → expected the same keys; actual 2026-09-30, 2026-10-12, 2026-10-20, … (every key one day early), no `sql` (in-memory path; `/analytics/sql` answers 501 for it).
3. Same with `"granularity":"month"` → expected `{2026-10: 6, 2026-11: 4}`; actual `{2026-09: 1, 2026-10: 5, 2026-11: 4}`. Quarter: `{2026-Q3: 1, 2026-Q4: 9}` instead of `{2026-Q4: 10}`.
4. America/Los_Angeles shifts identically; zero-offset (`Etc/UTC`, `Africa/Abidjan`) and positive-offset zones (`Asia/Tokyo`) do not.

## Mechanism

- `bucketDateKey` (`packages/core/src/utils/datetime.ts:313-334`) does `new Date(String(value))` — `'2026-10-01'` parses as UTC midnight — then `calendarPartsInTzOrUtc(d, timezone)`; there is no date-vs-datetime branch.
- `projectGroupValue` → `bucketDateValue` (`packages/objectql/src/in-memory-aggregation.ts`) passes `timezone` without the field type; `dataset-executor.ts` resolves it as `selection.timezone ?? contextTimezone ?? 'UTC'`.
- The parity gate `packages/verify/src/date-bucket-parity.ts` probes date columns only at UTC, and `engine-aggregate-timezone.test.ts` uses instant values only, so nothing pins this.

## Expected fix shape

A `date` dimension buckets on its `YYYY-MM-DD` parts directly (zone-independent) on the in-memory path, matching the driver; a `datetime` keeps the zone. Add a non-UTC date probe to the parity gate.

## Reach today and why it matters

Only callers passing an explicit `timezone` hit it: setting the org timezone (`PUT /api/settings/localization`) did not reach analytics in this build, and objectui at 4016370a sends no analytics `timezone`. It becomes user-visible on every date-dimension dashboard viewed from the Americas once the org/user timezone is threaded into analytics (ADR-0053 Phase 2) — fix before that lands.
